[[File:Devastator-ANH.png|thumb|300px|''[[Devastator/Legends|Devastator]]'', an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] described as a battlewagon]]

{{Quote|Next thing, three battlewagons start spitting out ident codes they'd never heard before.|"[[Down And Out On Coruscant]]"|<ref name="Coruscant">{{WEGCite|story=Down And Out On Coruscant|book=Dark Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
{{Quote|Princess Leia, we are falling into a stinger's nest. There are three imperial battlewagons in close orbit around the planet.|[[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]] | <ref name="Knight">"[[Black Knight, White Princess, and Pawns]]" &ndash; [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' (radio)]]</ref> }}
A '''battlewagon,''' '''battle-wagon''' or '''battle wagon''' designated a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] or other large [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. 

[[Kruk battle-wagon]]s dated to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and were still being used decades later in the [[Blockade of Sif'kric]].<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> In the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the term ''battlewagon'' could be used for very old, hulking ships such as the millennia-old warships of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot<ref name="Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> and the ''[[Cal Ambre]]'',<ref name="Cracken">''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]''</ref> as well as the decommissioned warship ''[[Wennis]]''.<ref name="Oseon">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]''</ref> Battlewagons could also include large [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial starships]],<ref name="Coruscant" /> including [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory-'']]<ref name="Revenge">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> and [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial-''class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="Knight" /> [[Bevel Lemelisk]] used the term to denote the Empire's [[World Devastator]]s.<ref name="Commander">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> The [[Black Hole-class Salvage Dreadnought|''Black Hole''-class Salvage Dreadnought]] was also known as an Ugor Battle-Wagon.<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
